# evaluation_seed_binding

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Refuses evaluation evidence whose result is not cryptographically bound to its declared seed.

| `deterministic` | `boolean` | yes | Whether replay reproduced the result exactly. |
